skill_name: Using the input, generate a paragraph discussing the implications of the recent technological advances.
workflow: Recent advances in AI and robotics have implications for the economy, democracy, and other aspects of our lives. For example, AI-based robots can now perform production tasks with high accuracy and efficiency, thus reducing the need for manual labor. This could lead to an increase in economic productivity and a decline in unemployment. On the other hand, AI and robotics may also lead to job losses and increased inequality as manual jobs become obsolete and fewer people are employed. Democracies
